title: Unit – 4 : Session – 3 : SLO – 1  |  Custom Higher-Order Functions
sections: 1. lambda — a lambda function in Python is a short anonymous function.
2. function — a higher-order function can take another function as an argument (or return one).
1. list(filter(lambda x: x % 2 == 0, [1, 2, 3, 4])) → [2, 4] — filter keeps only the even numbers.
Higher-order functions treat functions as first-class values: they can be passed, returned and stored like any other object.
